title: Melanoid Axolotl Babies
description: Adds baby variants of the Melanoid Axolotls by Konci for 26.1+ or the Tiny Takeover drop
body:
An addon pack for the Melanoid Axolotls resource pack by Konci that adds new baby variants for compatibility with minecraft versions 26.1+ or the Tiny Takeover drop

Note: I do not own or affiliated with the Melanoid Axolotls resource pack and it belongs to Konci, this is just an addon pack
